text:
Four signs your agency has outgrown WhatsApp groups. Number four costs the most.

Picture a typical agency on a Friday evening. A client asks where their reel is, and nobody on the team knows. This is a typical example, not a real client.

The signs:
• Deadlines live in one person's head.
• Clients chase you for updates on WhatsApp.
• Nobody can say who is overloaded this week.
• You find late work only when the client complains.

The fix is simple to say: every deliverable in one place, with an owner, a due date and a status, so overdue work shows up before the client sees it.
